packageRules.description: Group every non-major npm update by the workspace directory it lives in (root, packages/*, gatekeepers/*, collectors/*) into one PR, refreshed weekly instead of one PR per bump.
Flag every major bump (any manager) for human review — never auto-merged.
zod 3 -> 4 is a monorepo-wide migration (deferred) — keep taking zod 3.x minor/patch, never propose a major bump.
node:24-bookworm-slim (LTS) stays the pinned major across every Dockerfile — patch/digest updates only.
Digest-pin every Docker image referenced from a Dockerfile or docker-compose.yml.
Digest-pin GitHub Actions, keeping this repo's existing `uses: owner/action@<sha> # vX.Y.Z` convention (ci.yml).
Patch bumps to npm devDependencies auto-merge once required checks (guards/quality/test) pass, via GitHub's native auto-merge.
Patch bumps to pinned GitHub Actions auto-merge once required checks pass.

pi (@earendil-works/*) is a separate, never-auto-merged group — it must go through pi.version + the pi-drift contract (docs/runbooks/pi-upgrade.md), not a routine dependency bump. Placed last so it wins over the automerge/grouping rules above for any @earendil-works/* match.
